scoring_justification: T1 is infeasible because the transition moments depend on the external MINDO/3 calculation whose raw output is not available. The checker instead performs an internal self‑consistency recompute and structural trend checks (enhancement / suppression) using only the agent's reported values, adhering to the relations established in the paper.

hidden_assets.purpose: None needed; all checks use internal structure of the agent's artifact. The enhancement/suppression conditions and R‑value selection are derived from the paper's Table 2 and statements, documented here for provenance.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2 and descriptive text (model I enhancement at distances R=4.4–3.0 Å relative to binary at R=3.8 Å; model II suppression at corresponding R).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription of the paper's findings; no synthetic data created.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The checks verify structural consistency, not absolute values; they are faithful to the paper's qualitative claims.

outputs.description: This artifact contains the collision‑induced electric‑dipole transition moments for the b–a and a–X transitions of O₂ in binary (O₂+H₂, O₂+C₂H₄) and ternary (O₂+C₂H₄+H₂ model I and II) complexes. For ternary systems it also provides the SCF and CI components of the b–a moment. The checker recomputes self‑consistency (M_ba_tot vs M_ba_SCF+M_ba_CI) and verifies structural trends (enhancement for model I, suppression for model II) without requiring absolute‑value agreement with the reference literature.

output_contract.notes: Only transition moments (Table 2 equivalents) are scored; molecular‑orbital coefficient analysis (Table 1) is not required. The agent must use a MINDO/3 implementation with CI(SD) and spin‑orbit coupling, e.g. MOPAC.

steps.description: Verify JSON structure: all four systems present and each contains R_values entries.
For every ternary data point, recompute |M_ba_tot - (M_ba_SCF + M_ba_CI)| / max(|M_ba_tot|, 1e-6) and require ≤ 1% tolerance. Score = fraction of entries that satisfy tolerance.
At R=3.8, 3.4, 4.0 Å verify ternary M_ba_tot > 1.1 × max(binary M_ba of O₂+H₂ and O₂+C₂H₄ at the same R). Score = fraction of these three points that pass.
At R=3.6, 3.4, 3.0 Å verify ternary M_ba_tot < min(binary M_ba of O₂+H₂ and O₂+C₂H₄ at the same R). Score = fraction of these three points that pass.
